description:
We are Astra Pulsar, tackling the "Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer" challenge! We're building a gamified app using NASA data to make space science thrilling for kids.

We bring: Python/JS development, space science passion, and rapid prototyping.
We need: Game Devs (Unity/WebGL), UI/UX Designers, API Data Wranglers, and Storytellers.

Join our welcoming team to blend tech, art, and education into an impactful hackathon project!
summary:
The House Prediction Model is a machine learning project designed to estimate residential property prices based on property-related information. The application aims to simplify house price estimation by providing users with a web-based prediction interface. It is deployed on Hugging Face Spaces, making the model accessible online. The project demonstrates the practical application of predictive analytics and machine learning in real estate, helping users obtain estimated property values through an automated prediction system. The Space is marked as running on Hugging Face, although its implementation details and specific technology stack could not be verified because the live application timed out during inspection.
